en.headline: MUJI marks 25 years in Hong Kong with Central exhibition and Ferris-wheel installation
en.dek: The free “Origin. From MUJI” display runs until 29 November on the first floor of Man Yee Building, featuring a large Ferris-wheel structure and brand milestones.
body: MUJI is marking its 25th year in Hong Kong with a themed exhibition titled “Origin. From MUJI” at the first-floor atrium of Man Yee Building in Central.

The display, which opened on 6 November and continues until 29 November, uses a circle motif linking the brand’s products and everyday life. A large Ferris-wheel installation draws on the familiar Central skyline as a centrepiece.

Visitors can also see milestones from MUJI’s quarter-century in the city and selected products accompanied by notes on design thinking. The exhibition is open daily from 10:30am to 8:30pm and admission is free.
MUJI has operated in Hong Kong since 2001. The organisers said the show is a way of acknowledging long-term customer support.

zh.headline: 無印良品香港25周年 中環萬宜大廈展出巨型摩天輪裝置
zh.dek: 「原點．源於 無印良品」主題展覽即日起至11月29日於萬宜大廈商場1樓中庭舉行，設大型摩天輪打卡點，免費入場。
body: 無印良品為慶祝登陸香港25周年，於中環萬宜大廈商場1樓中庭舉辦「原點．源於 無印良品」主題展覽。
展覽由11月6日起至29日，以「圓」連結品牌商品與生活面向，並以中環摩天輪為靈感設置大型裝置作為焦點。
場內亦展出無印良品在港25年來的重要時刻及精選商品的設計小知識。開放時間為每日上午10時半至晚上8時半，免費入場。
無印良品自2001年起在香港經營。主辦方表示，展覽是為答謝顧客長久以來的支持。
